panels.description: Downstream Colorado water moves through a constructed wetland; it is visibly clearer but the inlet gate is nearly closed. A monitor shows CLARITY INDEX: 41 → 68. Leave upper-left clear.
A survey tray holds aquatic invertebrates beside a monitor reading DOWNSTREAM TAXA: 3 → 11 and WETLAND FLOW CAPACITY: FINITE. Leave the upper third clear.
A wall screen shows Croft beside his son’s treatment schedule; the son appears only as a pale hand beneath hospital bedding. Keep the patient partial and non-identifying. Leave upper-left clear.
Back in Nexus, Sitara watches the recording while Roman stands beside her unable to answer quickly. Leave the upper third clear.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: You want to stop the work that made this possible.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: You knew it was useful. You knew it was controlled. Why is it wrong only now?
